newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 52 mln of 1-yr index-linked bond.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 52 mln of 1-yr index-linked bond.

text.p: The Polish treasury sold 52 million zlotys of one-year index-linked bonds after investors bid for 99 million zlotys worth of the bonds against the 200 million zloty offer, the finance ministry said.
The treasury cut the minimum price of the bonds, due on March 4, 1998 to 93.50 from 96.67 at the last auction of the similar bonds on November 11, 1996.
The average price was also down to 94.10 from 96.74.
